reason: Only active reverse dependency is openidconnect 4.0.1. The OIDC callback uses public-key ID-token verification, not this crate's private-key operations. No upstream patched release exists.
removal: Remove when a fixed RSA release is available or the OIDC dependency is replaced. Any new RSA caller or private-key use invalidates this exception.

reason: Reached only through elliptic-curve 0.13 for P-256/P-384. Riviamigo uses age with X25519 identities only and OIDC with client-secret authentication, so the curve code only verifies public ID-token signatures. No secret-dependent operation uses this crate. The fix (0.7.6) needs elliptic-curve 0.14, and the latest age 0.12.1 and openidconnect 4.0.1 still require 0.13.
removal: Remove when age and openidconnect release versions on elliptic-curve 0.14, or when the dependency is removed. Any EC private-key operation, age P-256 recipient, or private_key_jwt client authentication invalidates this exception.

reason: Unmaintained, with no reported vulnerability. Used only at compile time by i18n-config 0.4.8 through age's i18n-embed-fl macros, to parse the i18n.toml files bundled in those crates. It never parses runtime or user input. The latest i18n-config and age releases still require it.
removal: Remove when i18n-config or age stops depending on basic-toml, or when a vulnerability is reported for it.

reason: Disputed max-stale/shared-cache advisory with no verified upstream fix. Used only by Docusaurus's update-notifier registry client, not an HTTP server or cross-user shared cache; got caching is disabled by default. Version 4.2.1 is unpublished; 4.3.0 does not change the reported max-stale path.
removal: Remove when the advisory is withdrawn, an independently verified fix is published, or the dependency is removed. Any shared-cache or request-header input from application users invalidates this exception.
